comment: The nine revert-checks of `stale-citation-resolution` (tasks 5.1–5.9) as a runnable set: one mutation per invariant, the named case must go red, the file is restored, the case must go green again. Run it with `bash tools/mutate.sh --mutations tools/resolve-stale-mutations.json`; `.pi/skills/mutation-runner` owns how, `.pi/skills/revert-check` owns the rule. Every search is a single line, because the runner's replacement is literal and line-based. The transcript is this change's `evidence/revert-checks.md`.

mutations.why: the trailing-boundary check that keeps a token cut out of a longer one out of the citation set
the rule that a header is only a citation when it is written as a path

mutations.search: < <(awk -v t="$tok" -v s="/$tok" '$0 == t || substr($0, length($0) - length(s) + 1) == s' "$idx")
mutations.why: the suffix test — a bare class-file name is a citation, not a bug
the submodule files joining the index, so a citation inside one resolves
the repair editing the citation token in place, so the body's markers survive
an ambiguous citation being reported rather than resolved to the first candidate

mutations.replace: bash "$here/update.sh" "$number" --status on-hold --comment "unresolved citation — $park_marker" >/dev/null || issues_die "resolve-stale: could not park #$number"; writes=$((writes + 2)); unresolved_items=$((unresolved_items + 1))
mutations.why: an unresolvable citation being reported and written for nowhere — a comment for it would put the verdict back on the item (#281)
only a park this tool wrote is reversed — a mutation that claims every hold makes a person's own hold reopenable (#281, --revisit-parked)
the pre-screen naming the absent token it reports, through the shared classifier rather than a rule of its own
the collapse of a citation that repeats its own directory, before the rename and symbol steps (#189)
the bound being spent only where a write follows — an item the ladder can only report costs no slot (#199)
a basename repair refusing an occurrence that stands inside a longer path, so the two loops cannot cancel (#200)
a repair counting only when the produced body differs from the input (#200)
a repair counting only when its rewritten citation re-classifies as a path the tree holds (#200)

mutations.search: printf '%s\n' "$body_matrix" | awk -F'\t' -v t="$1" '$2 == t { found = 1 } END { exit !found }'
mutations.why: a token the body does not carry being settled instead of rewritten into a no-op that parks the item (#226)
